title: Act: Add resolveTextureKey to the engine
description: Add a pure function that returns the id when the manifest knows it, and the fallback id otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown or undefined id returns the fallback id

steps.action: Append export function resolveTextureKey(id: string | undefined, manifest: AssetManifest, fallbackId: string): string. Return id when it is defined and some manifest.assets entry has that id; otherwise return fallbackId.
steps.expected: npx tsc --noEmit in game/ passes and resolveTextureKey is importable
